<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 160">
  <defs>
    <style>
      .storm-waves-layer1 {
        fill: #08232c;
        opacity: 0.30;
        animation: storm-waves-shift1 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      .storm-waves-layer2 {
        fill: #0e3543;
        opacity: 0.38;
        animation: storm-waves-shift2 11s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      .storm-waves-layer3 {
        fill: #154a5a;
        opacity: 0.45;
        animation: storm-waves-shift3 7.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
      }
      .storm-waves-crest2 {
        fill: none;
        stroke: #9edae8;
        stroke-width: 1.5;
        stroke-dasharray: 14 8 4 6;
        opacity: 0.35;
      }
      .storm-waves-crest3 {
        fill: none;
        stroke: #d8f4ff;
        stroke-width: 2.2;
        stroke-dasharray: 20 6 8 4 12 5;
        stroke-linecap: round;
        opacity: 0.65;
      }
      .storm-waves-spray {
        fill: #e6f7ff;
        opacity: 0.5;
      }
      @keyframes storm-waves-shift1 {
        0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px) scaleY(1); }
        50% { transform: translate(-60px, 7px) scaleY(1.08); }
        100% { transform: translate(-120px, -3px) scaleY(0.95); }
      }
      @keyframes storm-waves-shift2 {
        0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px) scaleY(1); }
        50% { transform: translate(50px, -8px) scaleY(0.92); }
        100% { transform: translate(100px, 4px) scaleY(1.06); }
      }
      @keyframes storm-waves-shift3 {
        0% { transform: translate(0px, 0px) scaleY(1); }
        50% { transform: translate(-45px, -6px) scaleY(1.12); }
        100% { transform: translate(-90px, 5px) scaleY(0.94); }
      }

  <!-- 奥の波（暗い青緑・ゆったり横揺れ） -->
